title: Building Energy Conditional Flow Matching: Six-Cohort Reliability Study
description: Historical Python source code, protocol records, model configurations, and verified aggregate evidence for a six-cohort evaluation of direct and residual conditional flow matching for building-energy estimation under distribution shifts (Cairo, EDCS, Miami, BDG2, Drammen, and Oslo).

creators.name: Rahman, Md. Mahbubur
creators.affiliation: Department of Mechatronics Engineering, Rajshahi University of Engineering & Technology (RUET), Rajshahi, Bangladesh
